[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a high-level overview of how the hybrid CNN-RNN architecture works, including the use of word embeddings, convolutional layers, and RNN cells.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the hybrid CNN-RNN architecture has been applied to sentiment analysis for social media text data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant cited a study from 2018 that achieved 92.1% accuracy in sentiment classification using a hybrid CNN-RNN architecture on Twitter data.
